skillDefs.name: Web-shots
skillDefs.text: Each spider shoots one web a fight: it slows the target and weakens its attacks, and stacks.

trait.name: Apply bleed
trait.text: Every 2nd knife on a target adds bleed. Stacks to 4, past armor.

trait.name: Waterhealing
trait.text: Its splash heals allies for its hit.

trait2.name: Medic
trait2.text: With no enemy in reach, shoots wounded allies.

trait.name: Stealthed
trait.text: Hidden until it attacks. Hides again 1.5 s after it stops attacking.

trait2.name: Shadow dash
trait2.text: Dashes unseen to targets within 10 m.

trait.name: Frost
trait.text: Beam stacks Frost: up to 40% slower. Melts 2 s after.

trait.name: Glut
trait.text: Eats kills: +6% health, +6% hit each. Max 3 a round, 15 in all.
